name: 💡 Resource / Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea or request a new AI resource for this hub
title: "[REQUEST]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: resource-details
    attributes:
      label: Resource Details
      description: Please describe the resource, tool, or tutorial you would like to see added.
      placeholder: "e.g., A step-by-step guide on using Gemini API with Python..."
    validations:
      required: true
